rust.name: src/store.rs:18:50: replace * with +
rust.why: Immediate warm reads and the zero-duration override can both pass when the default Copy lifetime drops from 300 seconds to 65.

rust.name: src/cli.rs:424:64: replace / with % in help
rust.why: The Copy can expire correctly while the CLI manual reports a lifetime of zero minutes.

rust.name: src/item.rs:238:52: delete ! in layout
rust.why: A legacy item with an explicitly empty Description field and nonempty notes is the boundary where the notes fallback matters.

rust.name: src/standin.rs:193:25: replace += with *= in answer
rust.why: The stand-in can return the edited fields while leaving the version and update timestamp unchanged, which write and readback assertions may miss.

rust.name: src/store.rs:203:9: replace <impl Core for Backend>::release_client with ()
rust.why: The stand-in already releases clients with a no-op, so its tests cannot detect lost release forwarding to the real Core.
